title: Ashfall County systems
concept: Lead a small community of survivors in a quarantined 4 km x 4 km county (2-6 km options): pick where you set down on a drop map, scavenge rucksacks of food, meds, ammo, materials and fuel for your home base, build facilities, recruit named survivors, and fight or flee a tiered bestiary (walkers to juggernauts) while AI rival crews and raiders loot the same towns and Guard airdrops and artillery red zones reshape each day. Destroy every plague heart to cleanse the county.
originality: Preserve the existing project expression and existing licensed-source boundaries. This migration neither approves new custom systems/assets nor proves distribution rights.
constraints: Documentation migration only; runtime, assets and player saves are unchanged.
Source-observed implementation is not marked verified. All new acceptance checks remain pending.
Use the existing owned-asset manifest evidence; declared selection does not prove import, active use, compatibility or redistribution permission.

players.notes: Mode counts are source/design declarations with per-mode limitations. This audit did not perform new physical-controller or separate-machine network tests.
